scenario.note: The question asks whether the total ration per person across all camps is at least 102 units (100 g per day). This is checked as a rule on the sum of ration over all camps.

The question asks whether a total ration of 102 or more per person is feasible. This is modeled as a rule that enforces a minimum total ration across all camps, with the objective still minimized to assess feasibility.
The ration for oil in Dayr_Az_Zor camp is fixed at 4 units (400 g) per person per day; the rest of the plan is optimized around this fixed decision.
